Read-only review complete. No defect found in the inspected diagnostic or retained results.

The residual-only exclusion is valid for positive eligible reference parameters:
\[
0<\mu\le H_{16}-c_T-p\le\bar\mu
\quad\Longrightarrow\quad
S_0(\mu)\preceq S_0(\bar\mu).
\]
Therefore negative genuine reference uppers at \(\bar\mu\) exclude rescue solely by reducing a nonnegative residual norm charge.

Endpoint directions and full-error treatment are correct. The diagnostic changes only \(\mu\), retains signed source arrays and \(\delta\), and uses the rigorous reverse-triangle inverse-energy lower bound. This does not require tail domination at \(\bar\mu\).

No true-Schur negativity, Weil negativity, optimality, or method-wide failure follows. No edits, tests, numerical jobs, or independent hash verification performed. Detailed review sent to Main.
